title: Mainstream Crypto
tagline: Easily send, receive or stream crypto dollars using Mainstream Crypto
description: Easily send, receive or stream crypto dollars (USDC) using Mainstream Crypto. Sending or receiving USDC does not require ETH since it uses meta transactions powered by Biconomy. It uses transferWithAuthorization for sending USDC and permit for stream token approval. USDC stream is powered using Sablier.
